chunks: He was sent as a caller to the Truth, and a witness over the creation,
So he conveyed the messages of his Lord without being lazy or deficient, and he fought the enemies of Allah without being weak or making excuses,
He is the Imam of those who practice piety, and the power of perception of those who achieve guidance.
ai.seo_question: What are the key characteristics of the Prophet's mission and leadership according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In the context of Nahj al-Balagha’s eschatological discourses, this passage emphasizes the Prophet’s complete fulfillment of the amanah (trust) and his role as a witness (shahid) over humanity on the Day of Judgment. It underscores the Shia understanding of his leadership (Imamah) as the guiding light for the muttaqin, linking his earthly struggle to his eternal status as the exemplar of piety and guidance.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Allāh deputed him (the Prophet) as a caller towards Truth and a witness over the creatures.
The Prophet conveyed the messages of Allāh without being lazy and without any short-coming, and he fought His enemies in the cause of Allāh without being languid and without pleading excuses.
He is the foremost of all who practice piety and the power of perception of all those who achieve guidance.
